intro.text: A thunderclast, one of two that rose from the stone in the midst of the singer army at the Battle of Thaylen Field.

items.text: Yushah's spirit sank into the stone near the bay by Thaylen City and took shape as a huge body soon after the other thunderclast, Kai-garnis. She crossed the battlefield, met Kai-garnis as it returned with the King's Drop, and was set by Odium to help guard it at the rear of his army.

When Lift went after the gemstone, Yushah pounded the ground to crush her, killing nearby allies, and finally landed a blow that badly hurt her. As Yushah moved to finish her, Szeth arrived with Nightblood drawn, cut her in two and destroyed her body.

appearance.text: A towering stone monster about thirty feet tall, shaped like a skeleton, with red eyes, arms as long as its body and hook-like hands. In the Cognitive Realm her spirit is the size of a building and twisted beyond recognition.
